intro: Visa-free entry for 365 days is the main reason for the mass relocation of Russians. The IT scene is concentrated in Tbilisi, Batumi and Kutaisi.
climate: Subtropics with mild winters on the coast and a continental climate in the mountains. Summers are dry and hot.
mentality: Hospitable and open people, a culture of feasting and toasts. High tolerance towards Russian speakers.
language_note: Georgian is the official language (with its own alphabet). Almost everyone in the cities and many in villages understand Russian.
visa_note: 365 days visa-free for Russians. Residence permit via employment, business, investment from $100,000 or marriage.
